reviewScope.summary: Draft visual-learning slice for Campaign M01, not the complete owner-requested editorial upgrade.
evidence: Inspected M01's committed 23-unit, 327-block snapshot, catalogue, external-source exporter, existing shared Git visual implementation and lesson-step model. Inventoried 152 exercises but did not complete their individual editorial/evaluator review.

21 illustrations across L01–L09 and LAB; seven have selectable example states. Unit IDs and exact prefixes checked against the committed M01 snapshot; the shared renderer provides cards, status, terminal and selectable frames. Shorter prose is presentation-only.
No authored asset, exercise evaluator, ID, content hash, progression, lesson position, persistence, dependency, or service changed. Added binding and example-state tests; tests not executed locally.
External pinned authoring workspace unavailable; do not treat this slice as the full requested M01 review. Actual build, test, browser, offline and production validation have not been observed.

adversarialFindings.description: Terminal location, saved file state, print arguments and error timing are hard to distinguish in prose alone.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Reuse shared visual frames and explicit text labels, with examples bound to existing teaching blocks.

adversarialFindings.description: Revising the generated asset without its pinned authoring inputs would break the reproducible source contract.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Keep generated assets unchanged and publish this visual-only slice as a draft; canonical exercise and language revisions remain outstanding.

adversarialFindings.description: An interleaved mission can change the relationship between mission step and unit-local block.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Look up M01 visuals by source unit ID and text prefix, without adding a lesson step; add a binding test against the packaged module.

retrospective.summary: Proceed with hosted validation of this scoped draft only. Do not merge as the requested full M01 release; authoring source and remaining review are needed.
